description: This stacked horizontal bar chart, titled "QA-2," displays performance metrics for two entities: an unnamed baseline (represented by the top bar) and "RedWhale (our)," with the latter explicitly labeled. The horizontal axis represents performance scores, while the vertical axis lists the two entities being compared. The value axis is linear and scaled from 0 to 100, with tick marks at intervals of 10, though only the numerical values within each bar segment are labeled. The top bar, corresponding to the unnamed baseline, is segmented into three colored parts: a dark purple segment labeled "92.9," a medium blue segment labeled "2.9," and a light blue segment labeled "4.3." The bottom bar, labeled "RedWhale (our)," is similarly segmented: a dark purple segment labeled "95.7," a medium blue segment labeled "1.4," and a light blue segment labeled "2.9." A legend at the bottom indicates that dark purple represents "Correct," medium blue represents "Partially Correct," and light blue represents "Incorrect." The bars are not sorted; the "RedWhale (our)" bar is positioned below the unnamed baseline bar. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, or outlining beyond the standard color coding defined by the legend.
